hook.name: PaperHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for a single ETH/token pool that levies a time-decaying swap duty — opening at a configured rate (e.g. 5%) and decaying smoothly to a resting rate (e.g. 1%) over a fixed window from the first swap — routing collected ETH directly to an immutable Pyx address via poolManager.take(), and emitting a daily record to a Foil contract after every swap.
